third_reading.remarks: On Dec. 14, 2015, the Senate passed SB02671 and elected their conferees with the ff. as members: Senators Trillanes, Legarda and Sotto. On Dec. 15, 2015, the Senate reconsidered the approval on Third Reading of the Senate counterpart (SB02671) of HB06268 and requested that the said bill be returned to Senate and to render ineffective any action taken thereon. On Jan. 18, 2016, the Senate approved SB02671 on Third Reading.
